|---|---|---|
| Wardrobe | (3.35, 0.30) | 180°—back against south wall, facing north |

The bed stays completely untouched and all furniture is retained. Cost: **0 dram**. Wardrobe front clearance increases from **0.05 to 0.95 m**; bed sides have **0.70/0.60 m** clearance.
